summary: Jack in the Box filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, disclosing a First Amendment to its November 3, 2025 Nomination and Cooperation Agreement with activist GreenWood Investors, LLC, extending the pact through the 2028 annual meeting nomination window. The board size remains capped at nine absent GreenWood's consent; the company will consult GreenWood on any new director, hold an investor event by June 30, 2027, and share advance materials without granting approval rights. Separately, the board appointed Rachel Ruggeri, 56, as an independent director effective September 17, 2026. Watch standstill compliance and governance influence ahead of the 2028 cycle.
